Every single transaction gets written down in a block and that block gets changed to the one before it. This creates a super secure permanent record that everyone on the network can see and more importantly, trust. So how do new blocks actually get added to that chain? Well, it happens through a process called mining. And honestly, it's basically a giant competitive race. You have all these incredibly powerful computers guessing trillions of random numbers every single second. The very first one to guess the right number solves a super complex puzzle. This lets you use that small amount of margin to control a much, much larger position. And what that does is it just dramatically magnifies your potential profits and — this is the important part — your potential losses. Now, with leverage, you can bet on the market going either way. So, yeah, you can profit no matter which way the market moves, but the risk of being wrong is just as massive in either direction. And that brings us to the scariest part of this whole thing.
